greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lweNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu kuni nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, usivele inceba. Kristu, usivele inceba. Nkosi, usivele inceba.
psalm_response: Nkosi, esi sisizwe esilangazelela ukubona ubuso bakho.
homily:
Kukho umzuzu, mhlawumbi uya kuwukhumbula, xa ubona umntwana efunda into entsha—loo mzuzu apho amehlo akhe akhanyayo, njengokuba uBen wayehlala enjalo xa wayecinga ngemidlalo yakhe yekhompyutha okanye xa wayejonga iinqwelo-moya kwisikhululo. Wayengumfana owayenomdla ongapheliyo, owayebona ihlabathi njengendawo apho angakwazi khona ukudala, ukwakha, nokufunda. KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu ujonge kwindawo yokugcinwa kwemali yetempile. Ubona abantu abazizityebi beshiya izipho zabo ezinkulu, kodwa amehlo Akhe amisa kwimfokazana, kwinkedama eyinkedama, efaka iingqekembe ezimbini ezincinci. UYesu uthi: 'Le nkedama ibeke ngaphezu kwabo bonke.' 

Masime kancinci kule ndinyana… Ibeke ngaphezu kwabo bonke. Kutheni uYesu esitsho? Akungenxa yokuba imali yayininzi, kodwa ngenxa yokuba yayiyiyo yonke into eyayiphila ngayo. Yayiyintliziyo yakhe yonke. UBen, ngendlela yakhe enobubele, wayeyiqonda le mfihlelo. Khumbula loo mzuzu xa uBen, eseneminyaka elishumi elinesihlanu, wathetha nabazali bakhe etsheho ukuba wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam owayesandula ukuhlaselwa zizifo ezimbini. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, kwaye yayingafuneki ngenxa yokuba umalume wayene-insurance, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. UBen wayengumfana owayenentliziyo eyayikulungele ukunika yonke into. Le yimfihlelo yobomi: asikokuba unika malini, kodwa ukuba intliziyo yakho ikulungele na ukunika. 

Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyanyana emihlanu idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, indlela yenu yaba ngumthwalo onzima kakhulu. Xa ucinga ngoBenjamin Vo, ngomntwana wenu owayenobukrelekrele obumangalisayo, intliziyo yenu iyavuzwa kukuba ngamanye amaxesha ukungabikho kwakhe kwenza ikhaya libe ngenye indlela. Mamele kakuhle namhlanje: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.' 

KwiNcwadi yeSityhilelo, uYohane ubona iMvana imi entabeni yaseZiyon, kwaye kunye nayo kukho abo 'bangazange bafunyanwe benenkohliso emilonyeni yabo.' UBen wayengumfana owayenoncumo olunyulu, owayehleka xa wayethetha nge-'con chim airlines' yakhe. Wayengumntwana wokukhanya. Xa uBen wayephila, wayephila ngokukhanya. Kwaye nangoku, nangona engasekho emzimbeni, ukukhanya kwakhe kusaqhubeka. Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo nolwazi, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. 

Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. UBen ngoku ungumntu okhululekileyo, ophilileyo, ojonge phezulu kuThixo ngoncumo olufanayo nolokuba wayesemncinci. Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando olungapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sesidlo sasezulwini, lapho indlu kaThixo izele khona ngabantu abavela kude nakufi, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona kwiSakramente eNgcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwayo yonke into, kwaye ndilangazelela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela ngokwenyama, nceda uze kum ngokomoya entliziyweni yam. Ndiyakwamkela njengokungathi sele ulapha, kwaye ndizimanyanisa nawe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undiyeke ndahlukane nawe. Amen.
closing: Ngamana uThixo onamandla angakusikelela, akugcine kwaye akukhaphe ngoxolo lwakhe. Hamba ngoxolo lweNkosi.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela umphefumlo kaBen kunye nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle ngonaphakade ekukhanyeni kukaKristu.
Sithandazela bonke abahluphekayo ngenxa yokulahlekelwa, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele abanike ithemba elingapheliyo.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Mna, Yohane, ndajonga, ndabona iMvana imi entabeni yaseZiyon, kunye nayo amawaka ali-144, enegama layo negama likaYise libhaliwe ebunzi lawo. Ndeva isandi esivela ezulwini, esinjengesandi samanzi aqhuma okanye isandi sokuduma okukhulu. Isandi endisivileyo besinjengesabaculi abadlala iihapu zabo. Bebecula into ebonakala ngathi yingoma entsha phambi kwetrone, phambi kwezidalwa ezine eziphilayo kunye nabadala. Akukho mntu unokuyifunda le ngoma ngaphandle kwama-144,000 abakhululwe emhlabeni. Aba ngabo balandela iMvana naphi na apho iya khona. Bakhululwe njengesiqhamo sokuqala soluntu kuThixo nakwiMvana. Emlonyeni wabo akufumanekanga nkohliso; abanasiphako.

readings.label: INdumiso
readings.text: R. Nkosi, esi sisizwe esilangazelela ukubona ubuso bakho. EkaNdikhoyo umhlaba nako konke oku kuwo; ihlabathi nabo bahlala kulo. Kuba uliseke phezu kweelwandle, walimisa phezu kwemilambo. R. Nkosi, esi sisizwe esilangazelela ukubona ubuso bakho. Ngubani onokunyuka intaba kaNdikhoyo? okanye ngubani onokuma kwindawo yakhe engcwele? Lowo unezandla ezingenasono, nentliziyo ecocekileyo, ongazifuniyo izinto ezingento. R. Nkosi, esi sisizwe esilangazelela ukubona ubuso bakho. Uya kufumana intsikelelo evela kuNdikhoyo, umvuzo ovela kuThixo umsindisi wakhe. Eso sisizwe esimfunayo, esifuna ubuso bukaThixo kaYakobi. R. Nkosi, esi sisizwe esilangazelela ukubona ubuso bakho.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Xa uYesu wajongayo, wabona abantu abazizityebi befaka iminikelo yabo kwindawo yokugcina imali, waza wabona imfokazana efaka iingqekembe ezimbini ezincinci. Wathi, 'Ndithi kuni inene, le nkedama ibeke ngaphezu kwabo bonke; kuba abo bonke benze iminikelo ngobutyebi babo obuseleyo, kodwa yona, ngobuhlwempu bayo, inikele ngayo yonke into ephilisa yona.'

day: Monday of the Thirty-fourth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you so much Ben! Ba má nhớ con rất nhiều mỗi ngày.
Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
